purpose: Search for experimental calibration and analysis files; no experimental fit claimed.

selected.result: Published yields and conditions available; matched calibration and original fit files not located in this search.

alternatives.result: Public files include detector and yield data, but the inspected projectile input explicitly has an M1 multipolarity block. Not a pure-electric matched reproduction.
Six public input files in root listing. Input references gdet.f8, gdet.f9, 194Pt.yld and other files absent from that listing. Complete analysis cannot be reconstructed from these files alone.

limitations: This is a dated availability audit, not proof that files do not exist elsewhere. No author contact was made and no external source/input files are redistributed.
